items.html: And you already know that Hesed is always on the male side. And behold, the light drawn from the upper throat of AA clothes in this Hesed, and when it goes outward, then Aba becomes the discernment of that Hesed, and Bina becomes the discernment of the throat, since it is the Bina of AA. For since the throat is higher than the Hesed, therefore the light of the throat clothes in that Hesed. It is found that Ima, who came out from the discernment of the throat, is more elevated, and she is concealed within Chochma. And this is the discernment of the letter Yud, in which Chochma is revealed and Bina is concealed within it, and is not revealed.
